BrokerApply.title: Become a partner
BrokerApply.lead: This application is a statement of intent reviewed by our compliance team. It does not activate any broker account.

form.licenceIntro: A copy of your licence will be requested by e-mail after this application is sent. There is nothing to attach here.
form.legalNameHint: This is the legal name under which your company is registered.
form.tradeNameHint: Optional, only if different from the legal name. This is the name your future leads will see.
form.countryHint: Determines the products offered in step 3 and the applicable pricing plan.
form.licenseNumberHint: This number lets our compliance team check your licence with the issuing authority before any activation.
form.licenseExpiresAtHint: An expired licence automatically blocks activation. The date must be after today.
form.licenseIssuingAuthorityHint: Optional, the body that issued your licence, useful to speed up the check.
form.productsHint: Determines the requests you are likely to receive. Select at least one product for the chosen country.
form.productsNone: No product is available for this country yet.
form.monthlyCapacityHint: Number of requests you can handle per month, so we never send you more leads than you can follow up.
form.contactNameHint: The person our compliance team will contact to review the file.
form.contactEmailHint: We will send you the rest of the file at this address, including the request for a copy of your licence.
form.contactPhoneHint: To reach you quickly if a part of the file is missing. International format, for example +225XXXXXXXXX.
form.whatsappHint: Optional, an extra contact channel if you prefer it, in international format.
form.planHint: Guides the review of your file towards the right commercial offer.
form.messageHint: Optional: any detail useful to review your application.
form.consent: I agree that this information is shared with the AssurMatch compliance team to review my application.
